lines.cap: The CIA once ran secret brothels in San Francisco, and spiked the customers with LSD. Then watched. This is real.
lines.say: The CIA once ran secret brothels in San Francisco, and spiked the customers with LSD. Then watched. This is real.

lines.cap: It was called Operation Midnight Climax. Part of a bigger CIA program, MKUltra. Started in 1953.
lines.say: It was called Operation Midnight Climax. Part of a bigger CIA program, MKUltra. Started in 1953.

lines.cap: The goal was mind control. Could drugs make someone talk, forget, or obey?
lines.say: The goal was mind control. Could drugs make someone talk, forget, or obey?

lines.cap: Agents hired sex workers to bring men back to apartments. Their drinks were secretly dosed. Agents watched through a two way mirror, sipping cocktails.
lines.say: Agents hired sex workers to bring men back to apartments. Their drinks were secretly dosed. Agents watched through a two way mirror, sipping cocktails.

lines.cap: It wasn't only strangers. In 1953, a CIA scientist named Frank Olson was secretly dosed by his own colleagues. Nine days later, he fell to his death from a hotel window in New York.
lines.say: It wasn't only strangers. In 1953, a CIA scientist named Frank Olson was secretly dosed by his own colleagues. Nine days later, he fell to his death from a hotel window in New York.

lines.cap: In 1973, the CIA director ordered the MKUltra files destroyed.
lines.say: In 1973, the CIA director ordered the MKUltra files destroyed.

lines.cap: But in 1977, around twenty thousand pages turned up, misfiled in a records centre. The Senate held hearings.
